layers.process: Mountain Zebra National Park: SANParks lists entry from 07:00 all year; exit is 18:00 April to September and 19:00 October to March. Times can change; confirm before arrival.

laws.rule: Eastern Cape Liquor Act section 59 prohibits consuming liquor on a road, street, lane or thoroughfare, or vacant land alongside it, in an urban area or other specified subdivided area.

Eastern Cape Liquor Act section 59 prohibits introducing, possessing or consuming liquor on a publicly accessible sports ground that is not registered, with an exception for registered premises on that ground.

sources.title: Eastern Cape Liquor Act 10 of 2003, section 59
